gagScene: Powerfully built {NAME} completes a low, sweeping throw across a battlefield, wearing a focused, matter-of-fact expression. Five shallow impact furrows mark successive skips through five enemy ranks; ten lifeless soldiers lie sprawled around each furrow, with the final group still collapsing outward.
